worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 48,000.00 = 48,000.00. Federal taxable income = 48,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 32,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 48,000.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 48,000.00 + 0.00 = 48,000.00. Schedule 2: no deductions; line 12 total = 0.00. IT-40 line 4 = 0.00. Line 5 = 48,000.00 - 0.00 = 48,000.00. Schedule 3: line 1 1,000.00; line 4 0 x 1,000.00 = 0.00; line 5 nobody 65 or older: 0.00; line 7 total = 1,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 1,000.00. Line 7 = 48,000.00 - 1,000.00 = 47,000.00. Line 8 = 47,000.00 x 0.03 = 1,410.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 1,410.00. Married filing separately is an 'all other filers' return: 1,000.00, only the filer's own exemption.
